description: Close an Open frame order so no new invoices may link to it. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set. Closing is not directly reversible; the order remains in the Closed state.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

frame_order_id.description: Id of the frame order to close.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: close_frame_order
